name: apple-ui-design
description: Design, adapt, and review evidence-backed product interfaces for iOS, iPadOS, and macOS.

interface.shortDescription: Design, adapt, and review Apple product interfaces
interface.longDescription: Three focused skills for Apple product UI direction, iPhone, iPad, and Mac adaptation, and evidence-bounded interface review. They produce design artifacts and acceptance criteria without claiming production engineering or native validation that has not been run.
defaultPrompt: Use $apple-ui-direction to define and render two distinct iPad UI directions for this brief.
Use $apple-platform-adaptation to adapt this iPhone editor for iPad and Mac.
Use $apple-ui-review to prioritize evidence-backed findings for this macOS screen.
